in_marathi.name: Gunvanti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gunvanti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gunvanti is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘gun’ (victory) and ‘vanti’ (bringer). This name is used for girls and signifies one who brings victory and triumph.
